item.title: Man Utd humiliated at Hull to open Premier League account
item.description: Manchester United lose 2-0 at newly promoted Hull City to open their Premier League campaign.

item.title: Fans and police injured in pitch invasion during ‘high risk’ German Cup tie
item.description: Waldhof Mannheim and Kaiserslautern game halted for 30 minutes as eight people hospitalised with about 100 injured.

item.title: Indonesia bolsters troop numbers to combat Borneo wildfires
item.description: Fires between January and July burned more than 200,000 hectares of land, says the government.

item.title: Is Trump making Latin America great again?
item.description: A right-wing wave is sweeping through the region and that is not good news.

item.title: As families retrieve bodies, Gaza is running out of places to bury the dead
item.description: Israel's genocidal war on Gaza has seen thousands of bodies buried in makeshift sites.

item.title: Jewish activists push back against Israeli settlers
item.description: Jewish activists provide a ‘protective presence’ to deter settler violence in parts of the Occupied West Bank.

item.title: CONCACAF asks Infantino to skip youth event amid FIFA governance crisis
item.description: The pressure on Gianni Infantino has led CONCACAF to reportedly ask the FIFA president to skip upcoming tournament.

item.title: The Berlin Wall separated his family. Its legacy still endures
item.description: When Germany was divided, the Guetingers were among the 70 million people split between two opposing nations.

item.title: Russian strikes kill 6 people in Ukraine, day after shopping complex attack
item.description: Meanwhile, Ukrainian drone hits home in southern Russia, killing two children and injuring their parents, officials say.

item.title: Hundreds of children take part in swimming class on Gaza’s shore
item.description: On Gaza’s shore, 1,300 Palestinian children joined a swimming class to cope with the trauma of Israel’s genocidal war.

item.title: Usain Bolt’s 100m record broken at World Humanoid Robot Games
item.description: Chinese robot reaches peak ​speed of 14.5 metres per second to beat Bolt's 100m record in Beijing, says state media.

item.title: Ebola continues to spread in the DRC as 16,000 vaccine doses arrive
item.description: Health authorities are warning that ‘approximately one person has been dying from Ebola every thirty minutes’.

item.title: More than 16,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine arrive in Ebola-hit DR Congo
item.description: The doses are the first of 70,000 allocated for Kinshasa as experts warn of the virus's exponential spread.

item.title: Pakistan’s PTI seeks contempt action over jailed Imran Khan’s hospital move
item.description: Party launches legal action after authorities take ex-PM to ⁠state hospital for check-up ⁠before returning him to jail.

item.title: Manchester City preview: Five key questions heading into 2026-27 season
item.description: Enzo Maresca faces the formidable challenge of following the legendary manager Pep Guardiola as new season starts.

item.title: Former world champion boxer Zolani Tete shot and killed in South Africa
item.description: Zolani Tete, who held WBF flyweight and WBO bantamweight world titles, killed at his home in Eastern Cape, South Africa.

item.title: Iran says new US sanctions violate sovereignty of other states
item.description: Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei slams Trump's latest threat as a return to 'full-scale classic colonialism'.

item.title: Australia bite back as 18 wickets fall on day one of second Bangladesh Test
item.description: Left-armers star in wicket bonanza as Australia take 101-run lead over Bangladesh on first day of the second Test.

item.title: Nakashima pounds Fritz, Bejlek beats Keys in Cincinnati upsets
item.description: Frances Tiafoe and Brandon Nakashima set up one all-American men's semifinal, Coco Gauff and Jessica Pegula also win.

item.title: How will Trump’s tariffs affect Canada’s economy?
item.description: US imposes 50% tariffs on key Canadian sectors after talks collapse, but unlikely to cripple Canada's economy.

item.title: Panama Canal to reduce shipping as ‘extreme’ El Nino approaches
item.description: Panama Canal will cut daily transits from 40 to 32 vessels by September 15, risking slower shipping and higher costs.

item.title: Lionel Messi fined for striking opponent in Inter Miami MLS game
item.description: MLS fine Inter Miami's Lionel Messi and Ian Fray for separate incidents in match against Philadelphia Union.

item.title: Libya’s brain drain, 15 years after Tripoli fell
item.description: Professionals who left a country in turmoil say they are unlikely to return as more in Libya could be planning to leave.

item.title: World Bank projects war-hit Lebanon’s economy to contract by 6.4 percent
item.description: Conflict with Israel derails Lebanon's economic recovery as inflation and consumer prices rise, the global lender says.

item.title: Somalia child hunger crisis deepens after aid cuts, UNICEF says
item.description: The drought-stricken country has recorded a 32 percent jump in the number of children treated for severe malnutrition.
